This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst, Identification Accuracy based in Romania.
 The Data Analyst will join a specialized Identification Accuracy team, helping ensure that device and browser identification systems deliver reliable, precise results at scale. You will investigate identification errors, analyze large volumes of event-level data, and translate complex findings into actionable insights for technical and customer-facing teams. Working with data generated by an API processing approximately one billion requests per month, you will help identify accuracy trends, uncover anomalies, and assess the impact of false positives and false negatives. You will also build dashboards, reporting solutions, and AI-assisted self-service tools that enable teams to answer recurring questions independently. This role combines analytics engineering, statistical reasoning, and cross-functional collaboration in a globally distributed, fully remote environment. Your work will directly support product quality, customer confidence, and continuous improvement in fraud prevention technology.
Accountabilities
Serve as the primary analytics contact for identification accuracy questions from Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams. 
Investigate reported false positives and false negatives, identify root causes, and communicate findings in a clear, actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Lead accuracy analyses for strategic customers and prospective clients, developing customer-specific metrics using their own data, such as account identifiers, when standard measurement approaches are insufficient. 
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports supporting Customer Success and Sales Engineering, including customer accuracy health reports and weekly portfolio performance summaries. 
Build and maintain self-service analytics tools, including AI-assisted solutions, enabling internal teams to resolve routine accuracy questions without relying on analyst support. 
Encourage adoption of self-service tools and improve how teams access, interpret, and use identification accuracy data. 
Model and maintain analytics datasets using dbt and ClickHouse, including aggregate tables, incremental models, and data quality tests. 
Ensure analytical datasets and reporting solutions remain performant, reliable, accurate, and properly documented. 
Monitor identification accuracy metrics, investigate time-series trends, and detect anomalies before they affect customers. 
Document analytical findings, investigation methods, and reusable playbooks to strengthen knowledge sharing across the organization. 
Promote an engineering-focused, data-driven culture by sharing effective analytics practices, tools, and technical knowledge. 
Participate in a shared on-call rotation, following a schedule communicated in advance and designed to distribute coverage fairly while minimizing disruption outside working hours. 
 Requirements
At least 3 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related discipline. 
Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
Strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international remote team. 
Advanced SQL proficiency, including common table expressions (CTEs), window functions, and efficient querying of large event-level datasets. 
Solid statistical knowledge, including metric design, impact measurement, and the ability to distinguish meaningful changes from statistical noise. 
Practical experience with analytical data platforms such as ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. 
Experience developing dashboards and working with data visualization tools such as Apache Superset, Tableau, Metabase, or Looker. 
Strong programming skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable code. 
Familiarity with Git, version control, and collaborative software development workflows. 
Demonstrated ability to investigate data discrepancies, identify anomalies, and reconcile analytical results with customer or stakeholder calculations. 
Experience supporting internal business teams through the management and prioritization of data and reporting requests according to urgency and business impact. 
Confidence conducting ad hoc analyses and presenting findings to cross-functional teams. 
Excellent communication and presentation skills, particularly when explaining complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and customer-facing colleagues. 
Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and approaches such as dbt, materialized views, incremental models, and data pipeline tools is an advantage. 
Experience with Python analytics libraries and tools, including NumPy, pandas, and Jupyter, is beneficial and expected for Senior Data Analyst-level candidates. 
Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, coding agents, or MCP to automate analytical workflows or develop internal tools is a plus. 
Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and model evaluation metrics, particularly precision, recall, and false-positive/false-negative trade-offs, is beneficial. 
Experience in fraud prevention, identity verification, device intelligence, or another domain where identification accuracy has significant business consequences is an advantage. 
Previous collaboration with Customer Success, Sales, or Support teams in a B2B SaaS environment is desirable. 
 Benefits 
Fully remote working environment within a globally distributed team. 
Opportunity to work with large-scale datasets generated by an identification API processing approximately one billion requests per month. 
Exposure to modern analytics and engineering technologies, including ClickHouse, dbt, Apache Superset, Prefect, Python, Jupyter, and Claude. 
Opportunity to contribute to AI-assisted analytics tools and advanced fraud detection capabilities. 
Collaborative environment with opportunities to share knowledge and influence analytics practices across teams. 
Salary range for the broader US-based role: $115,000–$155,000 annually, with location-specific ranges including:
New York City: $135,000–$155,000. 
Chicago: $115,000–$132,000. 
Compensation is determined by role level, geographic location, experience, and expertise.
